grade_age: Grade 8 (age 13-14) - a different grade than the two MCAS Grade 5 Science batches already merged (Spring 2025 merged, Spring 2023 abandoned mid-extraction last session due to an unrelated 13.8MB image-heavy PDF for that grade). Deliberately borrowed one grade level up, same rationale as the STAAR Grade 8 Science batch this round, to source content for the missing High Achiever difficulty band.

deferred_reasons.1: Diagram showing relative positions/sizes of several named galaxies (Milky Way, Boötes Dwarf, Sagittarius Dwarf, Large Magellanic Cloud) - visual-dependent, answer requires reading relative positions from the image
deferred_reasons.2: Four bar-graph options (kinetic/potential energy at two tree positions) - visual-dependent, the graphs themselves are the answer choices being compared
deferred_reasons.4: Four chemical structural-formula diagrams (bonded atom models for urea, CH4N2O) - visual-dependent, distinguishing correct bonding requires seeing the diagrams
deferred_reasons.16: Two paired graphs (line graph of download speed vs. distance, bar graph of download speed vs. three materials) that must be cross-referenced - too complex to restate reliably in text without risk of misrepresenting the data relationships

constructed_response_skipped.7: Three-part open-ended explanation (block/sand friction investigation) - no fixed answer, excluded per pipeline's standing no-fixed-answer rule
constructed_response_skipped.8: Three-part open-ended response (identify tool/fastener, describe use, explain safety equipment) - no fixed answer
constructed_response_skipped.9: Open-ended explanation citing two pieces of evidence from a continental-fossil map - no fixed answer

note: Item 3 (cellular respiration model) and item 10 (chromosome location / eye-color genetics, a two-part Part A/Part B item) were judged usable despite referencing a diagram/model, because the underlying content (reactants and products of cellular respiration; chromosome location and gene-to-protein inheritance) can be asked directly in text without needing the visual model - the diagram is illustrative, not load-bearing for the answer. Items 14, 15, 17, 18, and 20 originally reference a graph, diagram, or map but were judged usable because the data trend or spatial relationship is fully describable in text (e.g. item 14: bacterial antibiotic sensitivity declining from ~95% to ~65% between 1999-2015; item 17: Los Angeles is coastal and Oklahoma City is inland, a well-established geography fact independent of the map image). All 20 released items (13 usable + 4 deferred + 3 constructed-response skipped = 20) have official correct answers published in this document's item table for selected-response items; constructed-response items have no published answer key (scoring guidelines were noted as 'to be posted later' by MA DESE) and were excluded on that basis as well as being open-ended.
